references.evidence: The defining shawl feature is unmistakable: a single continuous gorge-free curve on both sides, so it is not a notch, peak or semi-peak. On variant identity, the silhouette matches the option's existing 0E blueprint (41b79662304b__090E__E_shawl.png) - broad bowed sides, rounded bottom sweep, short termination point. It does NOT match sibling 0A (d3b9f523a49d: straighter sides, long low tail) or 0005 (9345e8ee9d9a: narrow sharp V, long thin tail), both of which I opened to compare.
